summary: Use 6: #5 upper band + shooting star short, #46 aligned-momentum long, #54/#56 downtrend shorts, #62 uptrend long, #55 momentum long. Fix 2 that had a long/short divergence mix-up (#10, #57) - the corrected rules beat random in my re-test. Watch 5 (too few trades or a fragile edge, incl. #8 whose edge only exists with a 0.25 ATR stop). Drop the rest: impossible rules, checklist dumps, and setups no better than random. Honest note: the textbook 'band touch + divergence' setups from the 1-minute video tested at no edge on 4h/daily crypto when written correctly, so I didn't 'fix' them into losers. Concepts: drop 66 (ads, leverage, exchange how-tos, fragments, duplicates), reword 8.

setups.name: bb_touch_upper
setups.reason: Stats look great (86 trades, edge +0.36R) but they come from a 0.25 ATR stop: re-tested with a normal 1.5 ATR stop the edge falls to +0.09R. Garbled: you move the stop, not 'stop losses to take profits'.
concepts.fix_text: After the first take profit hits, move the stop loss to breakeven (your entry) so the trade can't become a loss.

concepts.reason: Run-on transcript; the point is position sizing on low timeframes.
concepts.fix_text: On low timeframes the stop is very close, so the same 1% risk allows a bigger position - a 0.2% move then makes a meaningful profit.

concepts.reason: The numbers don't match (3:1 but 1% vs 3.75%).
concepts.fix_text: Use at least 3:1 reward to risk: risk 1% of the account to make 3%.

concepts.reason: Hanging men are bearish, not bullish.
concepts.fix_text: Hammers at a low are bullish reversal candles; hanging men and shooting stars at a high are bearish reversal candles.

concepts.reason: Garbled: it's about moving the stop after the trade is in profit.
concepts.fix_text: Once the trade is in profit (after TP1), move the stop to your entry or slightly past it to lock in a no-loss trade.

concepts.reason: Fragment; the idea is value shift.
concepts.fix_text: Extend the range volume profile so it keeps updating; when the point of control moves (value shift) the key levels have changed.

concepts.reason: Fragment; the idea is single prints.
concepts.fix_text: Mark single prints (fast one-candle moves on the time profile) every day; price tends to come back to fill them and they act as support/resistance.

concepts.reason: A bearish divergence is confirmed by a RED dot, not a green one.
concepts.fix_text: A bearish divergence is confirmed when the candle closes and a red dot prints on Market Cipher; a bullish one when a green dot prints.
